\section{top — Entity}
\label{\detokenize{modules/top/entity:top-entity}}\label{\detokenize{modules/top/entity::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{modules/top/entity:vhdl-entity-top}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysigline
{\DUrole{k}{ENTITY }\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{top}}\DUrole{k}{ IS}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sampler top level.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Captures samples from a converter clock into the system clock, runs a capture
window under register control (APB in, through an AXI4\sphinxhyphen{}Lite register file)
and sends the samples, and a second external byte stream, through packet
filters. The converter and system clocks are asynchronous to each other.

\sphinxAtStartPar
AXI4\sphinxhyphen{}Lite register file for the sampler.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Five 32\sphinxhyphen{}bit registers: control (start, filter enable, clear), a read\sphinxhyphen{}only
status word (controller state, overflow flag), the filter threshold, a
scratch register and a read\sphinxhyphen{}only packet count. Write strobes are ignored:
every write updates the whole register. See registers/regs\_axil\_regs.toml.

Packet filter for a byte stream.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Looks at the first byte of each packet: if it is at or above the threshold
(and the filter is enabled) the whole packet is forwarded, otherwise the
whole packet is dropped. Counts the packets it forwards.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Reset synchroniser.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Takes an asynchronous active\sphinxhyphen{}low reset and delivers it to one clock domain:
assertion is immediate, release is held until STAGES rising clock edges have
passed, so every flop in the domain leaves reset on the same edge.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Sample capture across a clock boundary.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Registers samples from a free\sphinxhyphen{}running converter clock (adc\_clk) and hands
them to the system clock (clk) through an asynchronous FIFO. The enable
request goes the other way through a two\sphinxhyphen{}flop synchroniser, so neither
domain samples a signal that changes under its own clock edge.

\subparagraph{async\_fifo — Entity}
\label{\detokenize{modules/async_fifo/entity:async-fifo-entity}}\label{\detokenize{modules/async_fifo/entity::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Source file: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{src/async\_fifo.vhd}}.


\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{modules/async_fifo/entity:vhdl-entity-async_fifo}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysigline
{\DUrole{k}{ENTITY }\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{async\_fifo}}\DUrole{k}{ IS}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Asynchronous FIFO.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Moves words from the write clock domain to the read clock domain. Each side
keeps a binary pointer for addressing and a Gray\sphinxhyphen{}coded copy that crosses to
the other domain through a two\sphinxhyphen{}flop synchroniser, so only one bit changes at
a time and a pointer is never sampled half\sphinxhyphen{}updated.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Depth is 2**DEPTH\_LOG2 words. Full and empty are conservative: they may
assert a cycle or two late after the opposite side moves, never early.
\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{Generics}}

Sampler controller.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Runs one capture window per start request: it arms, enables the capture
path for RUN\_CYCLES clock cycles (or until the FIFO overflows), then reports
done and waits for the request to be withdrawn before it can run again.

\sphinxAtStartPar
State sequence: IDLE \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} ARMED \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} RUN \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} DONE \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} IDLE.

\subparagraph{Description}
\label{\detokenize{modules/sample_ctrl/processes/p_next_state:description}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
p\_next\_state: Combinational next\sphinxhyphen{}state logic.
A start request arms the controller; the window ends after RUN\_CYCLES
cycles or on overflow; DONE is left when the request is withdrawn.

\begin{figure}[htbp]
\centering
